row.name: Gamebird
mustPaint: plump rounded ground bird on short legs; small head
short rounded bill; short broad tail (fannable)
barred but low-contrast plumage; feathered feet
row.why: 8 misleading. Turkey, Chicken (comb, wattle) and Hoatzin (crest) stay caveat. The long-tailed gamebirds go to the Pheasant painting.
